fact: On 19 August 2026 the Interior Ministry said the National Population Register, interoperable with civil status and the biometric ID card systems, will allow secure authentication of users with public and private services, with a first enrolment phase in Niamey's five arrondissements in the coming weeks and extension to other regions in early 2027.
title: Tillabéri : Les réformes de l'état civil et l'identification des personnes physiques au cœur d'une rencontre d'échanges
